chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, and Sindī ibn Muḥammad, and Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, all from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Yazīd ibn Khalīfah, who said:
I was with Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام when a man from the people of Qum asked him and said: O Abū ʿAbd Allāh, do women perform salat over the جنازة?

So Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was, in the matter in which he declared the blood of al-Mughīrah ibn Abī al-ʿĀṣ to be without protection—and he narrated a long hadith—and Zaynab, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, passed away, and Fāṭimah عليها السلام came out among her womenfolk and performed salat over her sister.

key_terms.أَتُصَلِّي: does she perform salat; here, asking about performing the funeral prayer
key_terms.أُخْتِهَا: her sister; referring to Zaynab in relation to Fāṭimah عليها السلام
key_terms.النِّسَاءُ: women; the subject of the legal question in the hadith
key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or deceased over whom funeral salat is performed
key_terms.تُوُفِّيَتْ: passed away; describing the death of Zaynab
key_terms.فَصَلَّتْ: she performed salat; here referring to Fāṭimah عليها السلام praying over her sister
key_terms.هَدَرَ دَمَ: declared the blood to be without protection; a legal expression regarding forfeit of blood protection

ai.seo_question: Can women perform salat over a funeral in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of women performing salat over a جنازة. Imam Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام answers by citing the practice connected to the household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, mentioning that Fāṭimah عليها السلام performed salat over her sister Zaynab, indicating the permissibility of women offering the funeral prayer.
